blocks.text: DASMARINAS, Cavite—San Miguel Beer extended its PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series to a fourth game after holding off Barangay Ginebra, 101-98, and prevented a sweep on Tuesday here. Import George King overcame his struggles while June Mar Fajardo delivered as the Beermen escaped a last-ditch attempt by the Gin Kings to steal a win before a big crowd at City of Dasmarinas Arena. Scottie Thompson missed a game-tying three before RJ Abarrientos muffed a series-clinching four before the horn as Ginebra couldn’t close it out after winning the first two games convincingly.
